title: Gradient Regularized Newton Boosting Trees with Global Convergence
abstract: arXiv:2605.00581v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Gradient Boosting Decision Trees (GBDTs) dominate tabular machine learning, with modern implementations like XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost being based on Newton boosting: a second-order descent step in the space of decision trees. Despite its empirical success, the global convergence of Newton boosting is poorly understood compared to first-order boosting. In this paper, we introduce Restricted Newton Descent, a framework for convex optimization with Newton's method on Hilbert spaces with inexact iterates, based on the concepts of cosine angle and weak gradient edge. Within this framework, we recover Newton boosting with GBDTs and classical finite-dimensional theory as special cases. We first prove that vanilla Newton boosting achieves a linear rate of convergence for smooth, strongly convex losses that satisfy a Hessian-dominance condition. translated_title: 具有全局收敛性的梯度正则化牛顿提升树
translated_abstract: 梯度提升决策树（GBDT）在表格数据机器学习中占据主导地位，XGBoost、LightGBM 和 CatBoost 等现代实现均基于牛顿提升，即在决策树空间中的二阶下降步骤。尽管牛顿提升在经验上取得了成功，但与一阶提升相比，其全局收敛性却鲜有理论理解。在本文中，我们提出了受限牛顿下降，这是一个在希尔伯特空间上使用不精确迭代进行牛顿方法凸优化的框架，其建立在余弦角和弱梯度边的概念之上。在该框架内，基于 GBDT 的牛顿提升和经典有限维理论均可作为特例被涵盖。我们首先证明了原始牛顿提升对于满足海森矩阵占优条件的光滑强凸损失函数能够达到线性收敛速率。为了处理具有 Lipschitz 海森矩阵的一般凸损失函数，我们扩展了近期基于梯度的……
tldr: 本文提出受限牛顿下降理论框架，证明了牛顿提升树在光滑强凸损失下的线性收敛速率，并通过梯度正则化扩展实现了对一般凸损失函数的全局收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Restricted Newton Descent framework, proves linear convergence of vanilla Newton boosting trees for smooth strongly convex losses, and extends it with gradient regularization to achieve global convergence for general convex losses.
